_meta.source: NASA POWER daily (AG community), the same record as the cached climate features
_meta.method: last 5 complete years vs the earlier years; z = difference / (year-to-year SD x sqrt(1/n_recent + 1/n_early)); clear if |z| >= 2, possible if |z| >= 1; hot day = max >= 35 °C, frost night = min < 0 °C, heavy rain day >= 20 mm, dry spell = longest run of days under 1 mm in March-June, spring soil wetness = mean April-May root-zone wetness (NASA model estimate)
